cases.name: started-line-at-write-time
cases.detail: `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at9-beta ATM_TEAM=fx-at9 atm task start at9-1790200466-case1 "starting case1" --json` -> {"action":"send","team":"fx-at9","agent":"fx-at9-alpha","sender":"fx-at9-beta","outcome":"sent","message_id":"01M3847CC229857FWFYCHYRGZV","requires_ack":false,"task_id":"at9-1790200466-case1","summary":"starting case1"} identified task_id=at9-1790200466-case1 in the start response. Before alpha read it, `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at9-alpha ATM_TEAM=fx-at9 atm list --unread --json` already showed the row {"message_id":"01M3847CC229857FWFYCHYRGZV","summary":"starting case1","from":"fx-at9-beta",...,"task_id":"at9-1790200466-case1"}. Only then did `atm read --message-id 01M3847CC229857FWFYCHYRGZV --json` (as alpha) return the message with "taskId":"at9-1790200466-case1","taskOp":{"op":"start"}.

cases.name: out-of-order-start-reorders-queue
cases.detail: Assigned at9-1790200466-case2a then at9-1790200466-case2b as alpha. Started case2b (the second task) as beta: `atm task start at9-1790200466-case2b ... --json` -> task_id=at9-1790200466-case2b. Then `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at9-beta ATM_TEAM=fx-at9 atm task list --json` -> [{"task_id":"at9-1790200466-case2b","state":"active","position":1,...},{"task_id":"at9-1790200466-case2a","state":"assigned","position":2,...}], confirming the started task is active and ordered ahead of the still-assigned task.

cases.name: unstarted-task-keeps-reminding
cases.detail: Assigned at9-1790200466-case3 as alpha and never started it. Polled `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at9-beta ATM_TEAM=fx-at9 atm task events at9-1790200466-case3 --json` every 5s. At elapsed=120s the output contained handoffs[] entries {"kind":"task_ready","attempt":0,"at":"2026-09-23T21:55:15.698358792Z",...} (the first ready notification, also logged as events[].event="reminded" seq=2, excluded from the count per instructions) plus two distinct {"kind":"task_reminder"} handoffs: {"agent":"fx-at9-beta","at":"2026-09-23T21:56:20.690723995Z","attempt":1,"kind":"task_reminder","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case3","trigger":"task_pass"} and {"agent":"fx-at9-beta","at":"2026-09-23T21:57:20.696169275Z","attempt":2,"kind":"task_reminder","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case3","trigger":"task_pass"}. Afterward `atm task list --json` (as beta) showed the task still {"task_id":"at9-1790200466-case3","state":"assigned","reminder_count":3}, confirming it remained assigned (never started).

cases.name: cleanup
cases.detail: Closed all three created tasks via `atm task close <task-id> completed "<reason>" --json` as fx-at9-beta: at9-1790200466-case1 -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case1",...}; at9-1790200466-case2b -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case2b",...}; at9-1790200466-case2a -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case2a",...}; at9-1790200466-case3 -> {"outcome":"sent","task_id":"at9-1790200466-case3",...}. After each close (and at start of the run), `ATM_IDENTITY=fx-at9-beta ATM_TEAM=fx-at9 atm task list --json` returned [] confirming an empty queue before the next case.
